name: tx2gene
description: Which gene each transcript belongs to: three tab-separated columns, transcript_id, gene_id, gene_name, with no header line, one line per transcript in the order the GTF first names it. DERIVED from the vault's own annotation by bin/derive_annotation.sh, so its transcript names are exactly those in the fasta_txome asset of the same tag, which is what tximport and Salmon's gene-level summary need. Where a gene has no name the third column repeats the gene_id rather than being left empty. The tag is the annotation release, and the annotation asset is recorded as the parent.

required_files.description: the three-column table written by the DERIVE_ANNOTATION process
JSON record of how it was derived

required_assets.description: the annotation asset and release this was derived from; always given explicitly, since its name depends on the provider
